category: Purview, DLP & data security for Copilot
title: Set retention for Copilot interactions
problem: Compliance requires a defined retention period for AI prompts and responses.
steps: Purview > Data lifecycle management > Retention policies > New retention policy.
Select the 'Microsoft Copilot experiences' location (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and other Microsoft Copilots).
Document in your records management plan.
pitfalls: Retention for Copilot was separated from Teams chats — older 'Teams chats and Copilot interactions' policies need review.
Deletion runs via a timer job (typically 1–7 days) and is suspended by any hold on the mailbox.
done_when: A retention policy for the 'Microsoft Copilot experiences' location exists with the period and scope compliance asked for.
The policy is listed in your records management plan.
